# TECHMED

> TECHMED (techmedng.com) helps Nigerian students prepare for JAMB UTME and Post-UTME: study guides, classes, and free CBT practice on KAIRO.

## JAMB Oral English

- [JAMB Oral English, with audio](https://techmedng.com/oral-english): the TECHMED Oral English Guide's interactive page for UTME Use of English. Every vowel sound, consonant sound, word-stress pattern, emphatic-stress sentence and rhyme from the guide can be heard in British English. It includes a Word Bank of about 1,500 words (including every word used in JAMB oral English past questions) and five timed challenges built from 421 JAMB past and practice questions, each with an explanation. A free preview on the page has sample words to hear and six real JAMB oral English questions. The guide costs ₦1,000 and is included in the TECHMED Mastery and Ultimate plans.

## Practice and study

- [KAIRO](https://kairo.techmedng.com): free JAMB CBT practice from TECHMED with past questions in every subject and a daily quiz with a leaderboard. No activation code or PIN.
- [Resources](https://techmedng.com/resources): TECHMED study guides and ebooks.
- [JAMB syllabus 2027](https://techmedng.com/jamb-syllabus-2027): the UTME syllabus by subject.
